all-installments-summary: WITH S AS (SELECT M.CVE_CLIE,M.NO_FACTURA,COUNT(*) AS CHARGES,SUM(M.IMPORTE*M.SIGNO) AS TOTAL,SUM(CASE WHEN M.NUM_CARGO=0 THEN M.IMPORTE*M.SIGNO ELSE 0 END) AS DEPOSIT,MIN(CASE WHEN M.NUM_CARGO>0 THEN M.FECHA_VENC ELSE NULL END) AS FIRST_DUE FROM CUEN_M15 M WHERE M.NUM_CPTO=18 GROUP BY M.CVE_CLIE,M.NO_FACTURA) SELECT COUNT(*) AS INVOICES,SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(S.TOTAL-F.IMPORTE)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AMOUNT_DIFFERENCES,SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(S.DEPOSIT-COALESCE(F.PRIMERPAGO,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DEPOSIT_DIFFERENCES,SUM(CASE WHEN S.FIRST_DUE=F.FECHA_DOC THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FIRST_DUE_ON_INVOICE_DATE FROM S JOIN FACTF15 F ON F.CVE_DOC=S.NO_FACTURA AND F.CVE_CLPV=S.CVE_CLIE WHERE F.STATUS<>'C'
target-reconciliation: SELECT F.CVE_DOC,F.IMPORTE,F.PRIMERPAGO,F.NUM_PAGOS,C.SALDO AS CLIENT_SAE_BALANCE,(SELECT SUM(M.IMPORTE*M.SIGNO) FROM CUEN_M15 M WHERE M.CVE_CLIE=F.CVE_CLPV AND M.NO_FACTURA=F.CVE_DOC) AS CHARGES,(SELECT SUM(D.IMPORTE*D.SIGNO) FROM CUEN_DET15 D WHERE D.CVE_CLIE=F.CVE_CLPV AND D.REFER=F.CVE_DOC) AS PAYMENTS FROM FACTF15 F JOIN CLIE15 C ON C.CLAVE=F.CVE_CLPV WHERE F.CVE_DOC='F-EQ000082'
